label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

MARKET_HOUSE_COMMISSION_BPS.note: TEST house commission of 1% on a Market sale, so a journey can list and buy, and the commission leg posts. Blank in production refuses market.commission_not_configured.

MARKET_PURCHASE_HOLD.note: TEST: a Market purchase is held in the buyer's pot until its refund window ends (MC-market-02), so a journey can ask for a refund and see a release. The owner has not decided; production leaves it unset and every purchase pays through.

MARKET_REFUND_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: TEST refund window of two minutes, short so one journey run sees both a refund inside it and a release after it. Blank with the hold switch on refuses every purchase (market.refund_window_unset).

MARKET_RELEASE_SWEEP_SECONDS.note: TEST: the release sweep runs every 5 seconds. Blank, no sweep runs and held purchases stay held.

MARKET_REFUND_POLICY.note: TEST refund policy: the seller may refund a held purchase in full, so a journey can see a refund move money once. The owner has not decided; blank, every refund request and refund refuses owner.decision and the purchase stays held.
